items.name: Polllu-Sence
items.description: PolluSense is an AI-powered environmental monitoring system designed to identify pollution sources and forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) levels for the next 24–72 hours. items.name: SuperHeroFlightAndGrapplingRobot
items.description: A high-fidelity, bio-mechanically aware active ragdoll simulation built in C# and Godot 4. Modeled with Virtual Model Control (VMC) bipedal stabilization, dynamic line-of-sight cable wrapping, quaternion attitude dynamics, exposure-based fluid drag, and recursive subtree center-of-mass gravity compensation.

items.name: TargetTrackingRobot
items.description: A high-fidelity, high-density containment-escape arena built in C# and Godot 4. Modeled with explicit 4th-order Runge-Kutta tensor integration, 2nd-order ballistic trajectory prediction for 400 physics-driven arm segments, joint-space CCD with gravity feed-forward compensation, and real-time shader-driven terrain deformation.

items.name: blindBoxDating
items.description: 盲盒交友小程序将「盲盒」的惊喜感与社交交友结合，用户可以将自己的信息投放到「盲盒」中，其他用户消耗解锁次数后随机解锁，从而产生双向匿名交友的趣味体验。整个项目基于 [API工厂](https://www.it120.cc/) 后端服务驱动，无需自建服务器，开箱即用。
